definitions.explanation: A family's sole male child. Implies no other male siblings — there may still be daughters.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{一人息子|ひとりむすこ}だ。
{一人息子|ひとりむすこ}を{溺愛|できあい}する{母親|ははおや}。
examples.english: A mother who dotes on her only son.

examples.japanese: {両親|りょうしん}は{一人息子|ひとりむすこ}が{遠|とお}くに{就職|しゅうしょく}したのを{寂|さび}しがっている。
examples.english: His parents are sad that their only son got a job far away.

notes:
Compound of {一人|ひとり} (one person) + {息子|むすこ} (son). The reading ひとり is irregular for {一人} in this compound.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一人息子|ひとりむすこ}を{持|も}つ: to have an only son
- {一人息子|ひとりむすこ}を{溺愛|できあい}する: to dote on one's only son
- {大切|たいせつ}な{一人息子|ひとりむすこ}: precious only son

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {一人娘|ひとりむすめ}: only daughter
- {一人|ひとり}っ{子|こ}: only child (regardless of sex)
- {長男|ちょうなん}: eldest son — may have younger siblings
